name: Bonapartesaurus
sum: A herbivorous hadrosaurid of the latest Cretaceous of Rio Negro, Argentina, named after Jose Bonaparte.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Excavated by Jaime Powell and colleagues in 1984 and described by him in 1987.
